Paul Criticizes Government Spending
On Saturday, Paul took aim at federal spending in a post on
X
, arguing that government programs often fail to deliver their promised benefits and subsequently require more taxpayer money.
"Washington has a pattern. A new program promises to help, falls short, and then asks for more of your tax dollars to fix the shortfall," Paul wrote.
The senator argued that individual freedom and personal choice offer an alternative to what he described as a recurring cycle of government spending.
"Liberty breaks that cycle by trusting you to make your own choices and keep the rewards," he said.
Paul added that he makes the case for individual liberty in the Senate and vowed to continue advocating for it.
The post featured a graphic declaring, "Liberty is the answer, not socialism," reinforcing his opposition to greater government intervention in the economy.
